flag = b"FLAG{n0t_wr0ng_is_n0t_ok}"
encrypted = bytes([0x7b, 0xcf, 0x8e, 0x57, 0x2c, 0xbc, 0x70, 0x04, 0xbb, 0x34, 
                   0xc8, 0x1c, 0x32, 0xad, 0x6e, 0xf9, 0x8a, 0x33, 0xa5, 0x09,

# Ends with }

# Verification XOR loop

    xor_result = flag[i] ^ key
    if (xor_result & 0xff) != encrypted[i]:

    key = (key + flag[i]) & 0xff
